request.style: English, Americana folk, clear honest female vocal, acoustic guitar, mandolin, fiddle, upright bass, gentle harmonies on the chorus, hopeful dawn feeling, 86 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The city walls lay broken and the gates were black with flame
I sat among the ashes and I could not speak his name
I tasted only wormwood and I swallowed only gall
My soul remembered every wound and sank beneath it all

[Pre-Chorus]
Yet this I call to mind
And therefore I have hope

[Chorus]
The LORD's acts of mercy never cease
His compassions never come to an end
They are new every morning
Great is your faithfulness
The LORD is my portion, says my soul
Therefore I will hope in him

[Verse]
The grey light finds the window and the dark begins to fade
The night that I was dreading is a night that he has made
I did not earn the morning and I could not pay the cost
But mercy came to find me in the places I had lost

[Pre-Chorus]
Yet this I call to mind
And therefore I have hope

[Chorus]
The LORD's acts of mercy never cease
His compassions never come to an end
They are new every morning
Great is your faithfulness
The LORD is my portion, says my soul
Therefore I will hope in him

[Bridge]
The LORD is good to those who wait for him
To the soul that seeks him
It is good to wait in silence
For the salvation of the LORD

[Outro]
They are new every morning
Great is your faithfulness
